overview: Today's briefing covers national midterm political developments and global conflict updates, alongside local developments in San Francisco and Hawaii. In San Francisco, a downtown rental at the Millennium Tower reached ten thousand dollars, and the city is preparing a parade for the WNBA champion Valkyries. Meanwhile, Hawaii news includes proposed election tiebreaker rules featuring a lauhala basket and ongoing discussions regarding public information and Lahaina. No major commercial real estate specific items were reported today outside of broader political commentary touching on data centers.

items.title: A Midterm Campaign Dominated by Concerns Over High Prices Nears Its End
items.summary: As the midterm campaign nears its end, many voters across the country have linked President Trump's policies directly to inflation and high prices.

items.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say

wiki.title: Europejara
wiki.extract: Europejara is a genus of tapejarid pterosaur, a flying reptile that lived during the Barremian age of the Early Cretaceous epoch in what is now Spain. The only known specimen was found at the Las Hoyas site of Cuenca, a location noted for its exceptional Konservat-Lagerstätte preservation. In 2012, the new genus and species Europejara olcadesorum was named based on it. The generic name refers to Europe, where it was found, and to the related genus Tapejara from Brazil, while the specific name refers to the Olcades, an ancient people that lived in the region. The holotype specimen consists of an incomplete, crushed skull; the bones of the postorbital region are displaced while the mandible is almost complete.
